en:
Hello,
We plan to carry out an update that will affect the internal architecture of the application. We advise you to back up your registered plates just in case.
We have received your many emails regarding improvements. This update will not include them, but it will make it possible to move in that direction in the near future.
Have a nice day – Evasions Rebelles

This space will be updated with every major update.
